content.value: A double angel tie is 200mm X 100mmX 12mm (short legs back to back) of a roof truss in connected to the same side of a gusset, with rivets 20 mm in diameter, such that each angel is reduced in section by one rivet hole only. Determine the tensile strength of the member. Stitch rivets have been provided at suitable spacing.
